data.original_title: Thor: Shadow of the Nine Realms
data.overview: As an ancient enemy returns to smother the cosmos in darkness, Thor must defend the fragile order between worlds. His path brings him back to the mortal scientist he loves and demands a sacrifice no crown can undo.
data.tagline: When darkness falls, the realms answer.
data.title: Thor: Shadow of the Nine Realms
